literal_meaning: দাদার (স্থানীয় গুন্ডা বা নেতা) পেশা বা শৈলী
figurative_meaning_bn: অবাঞ্ছিত মাতব্বরি; কর্তৃত্ব ফলানো; নেতাসুলভ আচরণ/চালচলন/ভাবভঙ্গি
figurative_meaning_en: Unwanted bossiness; exerting undue authority; leader-like behavior or mannerisms (often implying thuggery or bullying)
example_sentences_in_english: He always shows off his dada-giri in the office.
history: Refers to the style of 'dadas' or local gang leaders prevalent in urban Bengali society, especially in Kolkata's street culture.
note: Common in contemporary Bengali usage to criticize aggressive dominance.
